Welcome to Moca ASMR — cozy, story-driven Husky ASMR and dog ASMR made to help you relax, smile, and sleep. 🐺🎧

Every episode gives Moca a new role or little adventure, blending spa ASMR, gentle brushing, calming massage sounds, soft fizzing foam, and funny surprises.

Expect:
✨ Relaxing ASMR sounds
🐾 Heartwarming dog stories
💆 Gentle spa and massage treatments
💤 Sleep-friendly videos

Put on your headphones, take a deep breath, and unwind with Moca. 💙

New videos every week.
